property_summary: For any calldata whose final two bytes encode a trailer of 32, C.owner() returns the top 20 bytes of the 32-byte word at byte offset 4 (the immutable-args region); the mutant reads the word at offset 0x2c, which lies past the end of the calldata and is therefore always zero, so it returns address(0) whenever the embedded top-20-bytes are nonzero.
change_summary: Read the address at immutable arg offset 0x28 (debt) instead of 0x0.
